total_mass.locator: MicroBooNE detector paper (arXiv:1612.05824), Sec. 2.2 (170 tonne cryostat capacity; Table 2 lists total liquid argon mass 170 tonnes)
total_mass.note: The quote gives the 170 tonne cryostat capacity; Table 2 of the same paper lists the total liquid argon mass as 170 tonnes (the table is flattened by PDF text extraction, so it is not quoted).
total_mass.quote: The LArTPC and light collection system are immersed in liquid argon contained within a single-walled cryostat with a 170 tonne capacity.

summary.plain: A 170-tonne tank of liquid argon on the Booster neutrino beam at Fermilab that photographs neutrino collisions in three dimensions with wires instead of film. It was built to check a puzzling excess of events seen by an earlier experiment.
summary.technical: Single-phase liquid argon time projection chamber with 170 t total argon mass and 90 t inside the TPC, 2.56 × 2.325 × 10.368 m active volume, 2.6 m maximum drift, 8256 wires on three planes, 470 m from the BNB target.

technology.quote: MicroBooNE is a large 170-ton liquid-argon time projection chamber (LArTPC) neutrino experiment
technology.value: single-phase liquid argon time projection chamber
